stations.title: Week's sales
stations.text: One scent per candle, repeats and all.

stations.title: Your code
stations.gap: No counts, only a long list

stations.title: Ines
stations.text: A count per scent and a pick for Monday.

captions: Copies stay copies now. On Friday Ines asks what sold best this week.
The sales are one long list of scents, and she counts them on paper.
You count with a Map, find the best seller, and drop repeats with a Set.
The report comes back with a count for every scent and the best seller.
Maps count and Sets keep things once. Next, the catalogue learns to be saved.
